entries.name: meridian.v1.Backfill.contract_version

entries.name: meridian.v1.RegisterRequest.schema_version
entries.empty: never empty: a plugin naming no version is refused

entries.not_meaning: the plugin's own version, or anything that decides its access

entries.name: meridian.v1.RegisterRequest.interface
entries.empty: unset when the plugin serves no interface to people

entries.name: meridian.v1.RegisterRequest.settings
entries.empty: empty when the plugin needs no setting
entries.intent: declares the settings an admin of the plugin must or may give it (W4.7, W6.11)

entries.not_meaning: the values, which the settings stream delivers

entries.name: meridian.v1.RegisterRequest.reads_external_accounts

entries.not_meaning: a role: what the plugin may publish is its roles'

entries.name: meridian.v1.RegisterRequest.declaration
entries.empty: unset from a plugin before v11
entries.intent: carries the version's declaration as the plugin's SDK built it from its code (W4.1, W8.1)

entries.name: meridian.v1.ToolDeclaration.name

entries.meaning: the words a person reads under the row of access that reaches it

entries.name: meridian.v1.ToolDeclaration.description
entries.intent: tells an agent what the tool does and answers
entries.meaning: the vendor's text, which the dashboard prefixes with the plugin's title and instance before an agent reads it

entries.intent: counts the statement's rows
entries.meaning: every row recorded, resolved or not

entries.name: meridian.v1.StatementRecordedEvent.rows_resolved
entries.intent: counts the rows that named an instrument
entries.meaning: rows that updated a position

entries.name: meridian.v1.StatementRecordedEvent.rows_unresolved
entries.empty: 0 when every row resolved: the only quiet outcome
entries.intent: counts the rows the deployment could not name
entries.meaning: the number a person watches

entries.name: meridian.v1.StatementRecordedEvent.recorded_at_ns
entries.intent: records when the statement completed
entries.meaning: the deployment's clock when its last row landed
entries.not_meaning: when it was read, or the date it reflects

entries.name: meridian.v1.StatementRecordedEvent.account_id
entries.intent: names the account the statement is of
entries.meaning: its external account's linked account, or, from a plugin before v7, its rows'

entries.name: meridian.v1.StatementRecordedEvent.figures
entries.empty: empty where the statement carried none
entries.intent: carries the statement's figures as recorded
entries.meaning: one set per segment, as reported

entries.name: meridian.v1.StatementRecordedEvent.currency_assumed
entries.empty: false when the source stated the figures' currency
entries.intent: says the figures' currency is the plugin's assumption
entries.meaning: as the statement said

entries.name: meridian.v1.StatementRecordedEvent.journal
entries.intent: says where the completion sits in the street's record
entries.meaning: its number in the street's partition, chained per account with the statements before it

entries.name: meridian.v1.StatementRecordedEvent.cause
entries.intent: says who caused the completion
entries.meaning: the row whose landing completed it

entries.name: meridian.v1.StatementRecordedEvent.external_account_id
entries.empty: empty from a plugin before v7
entries.intent: names the external account the statement was of
entries.meaning: as the statement named it: with the source and a segment, what a margin agreement is keyed by and an opening balance names as its source

entries.name: meridian.v1.StatementRecordedEvent.institution
entries.empty: empty from a plugin before v7, and where the plugin did not say
entries.intent: names the institution holding the external account
entries.meaning: as the statement named it

entries.name: meridian.v1.StatementRecordedEvent.security_interest
entries.empty: unset where the statement did not say, which is not false
entries.intent: says the account servicer holds a lien or a right of set-off over the account
entries.meaning: as the statement reported it

entries.name: meridian.v1.StatementRecordedEvent.raw_record
entries.empty: unset from a plugin before v11; the custody suite requires it
entries.intent: references the raw record the statement's figures was converted from
entries.meaning: the record in the plugin's own storage, which a person follows on that plugin's page; a value derived wholly by the plugin names the record it was derived from
entries.not_meaning: a record core or another plugin reads: carried, never followed, past the plugin that owns it

entries.name: meridian.v1.StatementRecordedEvent.provenance
entries.empty: empty where every value is the source's, from the raw record
entries.intent: says where each value the plugin closed rather than read came from
entries.meaning: one per closed value, by its path: derived by a named rule, supplied by a named person, from a second source, or reported from another of the source's records
entries.not_meaning: a value presented as the source's: a closed value never is

entries.name: meridian.v1.CustodialPositionUpdatedEvent.position
entries.intent: carries the custodial position that changed
entries.meaning: its whole new state

entries.name: meridian.v1.CustodialPositionUpdatedEvent.statement_id
entries.empty: empty for a change no statement caused, as a record merged into another
entries.intent: names the statement that changed the position
entries.meaning: so a reader can explain any position by what produced it

entries.name: meridian.v1.CustodialPositionUpdatedEvent.previous_quantity
entries.unit: units of the instrument; for cash, the currency's major unit
entries.empty: 0 for a position that is new
entries.intent: lets a reader show a change without its own history
entries.meaning: the trade-date quantity before the change

entries.name: meridian.v1.CustodialPositionUpdatedEvent.journal
entries.intent: says where the change sits in the street's record
entries.meaning: its number in the street's partition, chained per account with the positions changed before it

entries.name: meridian.v1.CustodialPositionUpdatedEvent.cause
entries.intent: says who caused the change
entries.meaning: the command that changed the position

entries.name: meridian.v1.CustodialPosition.account_id
entries.intent: names the account the position is of
entries.meaning: the deployment's account

entries.name: meridian.v1.CustodialPosition.instrument_id
entries.intent: names the instrument held
entries.meaning: the deployment's record, whatever its identifier; a record a person merged into another moves onto the one that stays (W3.9)

entries.name: meridian.v1.CustodialPosition.side

allowed.meaning: not said; never on a position the street answers
held long
held short

entries.intent: says which side the position is on
entries.meaning: keyed by account, instrument and side: an account may hold an instrument long and short at once

entries.name: meridian.v1.CustodialPosition.quantity
entries.unit: units of the instrument; for cash, the currency's major unit
entries.intent: says the trade-date quantity the custodian says the account holds
entries.meaning: as the last statement stated it, signed to match side
entries.not_meaning: the book's position, which is a different number whose disagreement is the subject of reconciliation

entries.name: meridian.v1.CustodialPosition.settle_date_quantity
entries.unit: units of the instrument; for cash, the currency's major unit
entries.empty: unset where the custodian reported none, which is not zero
entries.intent: says the settle-date quantity
entries.meaning: as the last statement stated it

entries.name: meridian.v1.CustodialPosition.market_value
entries.empty: unset where the custodian reported no value, which is not zero
entries.intent: carries the custodian's valuation
entries.meaning: as the last statement stated it

entries.name: meridian.v1.CustodialPosition.last_statement_id
entries.intent: names the statement that last stated the position
entries.meaning: the street's statement identifier
entries.not_meaning: a statement that changed it: one not restated recently is not wrong, and worth showing differently

entries.name: meridian.v1.CustodialPosition.as_of_date
entries.intent: says the date the position was last stated as of
entries.meaning: the last statement's as-of date

entries.name: meridian.v1.CustodialPosition.updated_at_ns
entries.intent: records when the street last changed the position
entries.meaning: the deployment's clock
entries.not_meaning: the date it is as of

entries.name: meridian.v1.CustodialPosition.also_counted_in_cash
entries.empty: false when the custodian counts the holding once, and on every position a plugin on v11 stated
entries.intent: said, until v11, that the position's value is also in the account's cash as the custodian reports it
entries.meaning: both are kept as reported

deprecated.why: each asset is counted once at the edge; no reader acts on it

entries.name: meridian.v1.CustodialPosition.cost_basis
entries.empty: unset where the custodian reported none
entries.intent: carries the position's total cost
entries.meaning: as the custodian reported it on the row that last stated the position

entries.name: meridian.v1.CustodialPosition.lots
entries.empty: empty where the custodian listed none
entries.intent: carries the position's lots as the custodian listed them
entries.meaning: from the row that last stated the position

entries.name: meridian.v1.CustodialPosition.margin_requirement
entries.empty: unset where the custodian reported none, which is not zero
entries.intent: carries the margin the position requires
entries.meaning: as reported on the row that last stated it
entries.not_meaning: a figure derived from a rate

entries.name: meridian.v1.CustodialPosition.last_change
entries.intent: says where the position's last change sits in the street's record
entries.meaning: a delivery at or below it is already in it
entries.not_meaning: the statement that last stated it

entries.name: meridian.v1.CustodialPosition.removed
entries.empty: false for a position that stands
entries.intent: marks a position that is gone
entries.meaning: a tombstone (W2.6, W3.9): returned only to a read since a watermark, and delivered once

entries.name: meridian.v1.CustodialPosition.average_cost
entries.empty: unset where the custodian reported none
entries.intent: carries the custodian's average cost per unit
entries.meaning: as on RecordHoldingRequest, from the row that last stated the position
entries.not_meaning: a figure anything multiplies by the quantity

entries.name: meridian.v1.CustodialPosition.available_quantity
entries.empty: unset where the custodian gave none: never zero, never the quantity
entries.intent: carries how much the custodian reports available
entries.meaning: as on RecordHoldingRequest, from the row that last stated the position

entries.name: meridian.v1.CustodialPosition.not_available_quantity
entries.empty: unset where the custodian gave none, which is not zero
entries.intent: carries how much the custodian reports not available
entries.meaning: as on RecordHoldingRequest

entries.name: meridian.v1.CustodialPosition.available_basis

allowed.meaning: the custodian does not say
net of what has settled
net of what has traded
net of what is contractually due
net of the source's open orders

entries.intent: says what the available figure is net of
entries.meaning: as on RecordHoldingRequest

entries.name: meridian.v1.CustodialPosition.encumbrances
entries.empty: empty means none reported, not none held
entries.intent: carries the sub-balances the custodian reports encumbered
entries.meaning: as on RecordHoldingRequest, from the row that last stated the position

entries.name: meridian.v1.CustodialPosition.raw_record
entries.empty: unset where the row that last stated it carried none
entries.intent: references the raw record the row that last stated it was converted from
entries.meaning: the record in the plugin's own storage, which a person follows on that plugin's page; a value derived wholly by the plugin names the record it was derived from
entries.not_meaning: a record core or another plugin reads: carried, never followed, past the plugin that owns it

entries.name: meridian.v1.CustodialPosition.provenance
entries.empty: empty where every value is the source's, from the raw record
entries.intent: says where each value the plugin closed rather than read came from
entries.meaning: one per closed value, by its path: derived by a named rule, supplied by a named person, from a second source, or reported from another of the source's records
entries.not_meaning: a value presented as the source's: a closed value never is

entries.name: meridian.v1.CustodialPosition.pending
entries.intent: states the quantities not yet settled, each by its value date
entries.meaning: as the row that last stated the position carried them, with what a backfill added

entries.name: meridian.v1.ListCustodialPositionsRequest.account_id
entries.empty: empty for every account in the reader's scope (W4.11)
entries.intent: names the account to read
entries.meaning: an account in the plugin's read scope; one outside it is refused before it leaves the sidecar

entries.name: meridian.v1.ListCustodialPositionsRequest.include_unresolved
entries.intent: asks for the holdings that never resolved beside the positions
entries.meaning: so one read answers both what the custodian says is held and what could not be accounted for

entries.name: meridian.v1.ListCustodialPositionsRequest.page_size
entries.intent: bounds a page
entries.meaning: how many positions a page holds at most
entries.not_meaning: a promise that a page is full

entries.name: meridian.v1.ListCustodialPositionsRequest.cursor
entries.intent: asks for the next page
entries.meaning: opaque: the previous reply's next_cursor; unresolved holdings come with the first page only, so a read across pages sees each once

entries.name: meridian.v1.ListCustodialPositionsRequest.since
entries.intent: asks only for what changed after a point
entries.meaning: positions whose last change is above it, tombstones included

entries.name: meridian.v1.ListCustodialPositionsReply.positions
entries.empty: empty when none is in scope
entries.intent: answers the positions
entries.meaning: within the reader's scope, a page at a time

entries.name: meridian.v1.ListCustodialPositionsReply.unresolved
entries.empty: empty unless include_unresolved was set, and after the first page
entries.intent: answers the holdings that never resolved
entries.meaning: within the reader's scope

entries.name: meridian.v1.ListCustodialPositionsReply.next_cursor
entries.intent: points at the next page
entries.meaning: opaque, passed back as cursor

entries.name: meridian.v1.ListCustodialPositionsReply.as_of
entries.intent: says the point in the street's record the page was read at
entries.meaning: what a reader passes as since to read only what changed after

entries.name: meridian.v1.UnresolvedHolding.holding_id
entries.intent: identifies the row that never resolved
entries.meaning: the street's identifier for the row

entries.name: meridian.v1.UnresolvedHolding.account_id
entries.intent: names the account the row is of
entries.meaning: the deployment's account

entries.name: meridian.v1.UnresolvedHolding.identifiers
entries.intent: carries what the plugin held for the row
entries.meaning: every identifier its source gave

entries.name: meridian.v1.UnresolvedHolding.quantity
entries.intent: says how much the row held
entries.meaning: signed as the row stated it, negative short

entries.name: meridian.v1.UnresolvedHolding.market_value
entries.empty: unset where the custodian reported no value, which is not zero
entries.intent: carries the custodian's valuation of the row
entries.meaning: as reported

entries.name: meridian.v1.UnresolvedHolding.source
entries.intent: names the row's source
entries.meaning: the plugin's scheme for its source

entries.name: meridian.v1.UnresolvedHolding.as_of_date
entries.intent: says the date the row was as of
entries.meaning: its statement's as-of date

entries.name: meridian.v1.UnresolvedHolding.escalated
entries.empty: false while nobody has raised it
entries.intent: says an escalation was raised for the row's identifiers
entries.meaning: so a view can tell what nobody has looked at from what is with the administrator

entries.name: meridian.v1.UnresolvedHolding.raw_record
entries.empty: unset where the row carried none
entries.intent: references the raw record the row was converted from
entries.meaning: as the row carried it
entries.not_meaning: a record anyone but its plugin reads

entries.name: meridian.v1.ListStatementsRequest.account_id
entries.empty: empty for every account in the reader's scope
entries.intent: names the account whose statements to read
entries.meaning: an account in the plugin's read scope

entries.name: meridian.v1.ListStatementsRequest.as_of_date
entries.intent: narrows to statements as of a date
entries.meaning: an ISO 8601 date

entries.name: meridian.v1.ListStatementsRequest.since
entries.intent: asks only for statements completed after a point
entries.meaning: a point in the street's record

entries.name: meridian.v1.ListStatementsRequest.page_size
entries.intent: bounds a page
entries.meaning: how many statements a page holds at most
entries.not_meaning: a promise that a page is full

entries.name: meridian.v1.ListStatementsRequest.cursor
entries.intent: asks for the next page
entries.meaning: opaque: the previous reply's next_cursor

entries.name: meridian.v1.ListStatementsReply.statements
entries.empty: empty when none is in scope
entries.intent: answers completed statements and their figures
entries.meaning: each as it was announced (W2.5); an open statement is not listed

entries.name: meridian.v1.ListStatementsReply.next_cursor
entries.intent: points at the next page
entries.meaning: opaque, passed back as cursor

entries.name: meridian.v1.ListStatementsReply.as_of
entries.intent: says the point in the street's record the page was read at
entries.meaning: what a reader passes as since

entries.name: meridian.v1.ExternalAccountsEvent.accounts
entries.empty: empty when the connection reaches none
entries.intent: lists every external account a connection reaches, as the plugin sees it now
entries.meaning: the whole list each time, published before anything is recorded against any of them, so linking one (W6.4) is a choice among those on offer; one missing from it is one the connection no longer reaches

entries.name: meridian.v1.ExternalAccount.external_account_id
entries.intent: identifies an external account, stably
entries.meaning: stable across the connection's reconnections, which the plugin makes so where its source does not; the external_account_id the account's rows name; a handle the source wants on each call stays inside the plugin

entries.name: meridian.v1.ExternalAccount.name
entries.empty: empty where the custodian gives none
entries.intent: names the external account as a person there would recognise it
entries.meaning: the custodian's own name for it

entries.name: meridian.v1.ExternalAccount.venue_account_type
entries.empty: empty where the custodian gives none, and from a plugin on v11
entries.intent: showed, until v11, the custodian's own word for the kind of account
entries.meaning: verbatim and for display only; accepted from a plugin before v11 for its notice, and shown only where no kind is sent
entries.not_meaning: what the account may do: nothing reads meaning into it

deprecated.why: the plugin converts the venue's type to the account kind, and sends it as reported only when it does not convert

entries.name: meridian.v1.ExternalAccount.account_kind

allowed.meaning: not known: the custodian's type says neither cash nor margin nor retirement; what a plugin sends when the type does not convert, with the type as reported beside it
trades settle in full from the account's own cash, with no borrowing
the account may borrow against its holdings under a margin agreement
a tax-advantaged retirement account, whether or not it allows limited margin

entries.empty: unspecified is not known, and then the custodian's type travels as reported
entries.intent: says the account's kind, in the platform's own words
entries.meaning: converted by the plugin from the custodian's own type; for display and for grouping accounts across plugins
entries.not_meaning: what the account may do, which is the platform's restriction set when it is ruled; nothing gates on the kind

entries.name: meridian.v1.ExternalAccount.account_kind_as_reported
entries.empty: unset whenever the kind is known: set only beside a kind not known
entries.intent: carries the custodian's type that did not convert to a kind
entries.meaning: for a person to map, and counted as evidence the kinds may need to grow
entries.not_meaning: a kind any reader may act on: nothing past the plugin interprets it
